about_the_game:
2027. The world survived — but not as we knew it. A year has passed since the peak of the World War, leaving the surface covered in radioactive dust.

Under Protocol is a tense checkpoint simulation set deep underground. Every decision you make affects the fate of those in front of you — and your family’s chance to escape to a safe region.

How It Plays

There’s a line at the checkpoint. People arrive with different stories, professions, papers, and goals: some seek refuge, some need work, some try to bring in what they shouldn’t.
The choice is yours. Approve or deny—every decision affects your reputation, bonuses, and risk.

Document Checks

  • Verify identity: photo, full name, date of birth, ID numbers, matching stamps and seals.

  • Cross-check biography and education.

  • Use the internal database to verify document authenticity.

Radiation Monitoring

  • Measure the dose rate (µSv/h) with a portable dosimeter.

  • Compare the reading against the in-game table of permissible levels—thresholds vary by role and condition.

Baggage Scanner

Run items through the X-ray scanner. Watch for contraband, weapons, radioactive materials, and illegal substances. Separate the harmless from the prohibited.

CCTV Camera

Periodically check the CCTV monitor.
Respond to alerts—camera blackouts, suspicious objects or silhouettes. Ignoring them can be costly.

Risks & Consequences

  • Reputation. With command—for discipline and metrics; with residents—for compassion or toughness; with the black market—for “cooperation” or integrity.

  • Economy. Salary; fines for mistakes; bounties for violations caught; expenses for medicine, filters, and rations. Every error pushes your Siberia dream further out of reach.

  • Health. Working by the entrance and constant inspections increase your cumulative dose. Shields, graphite/lead panels, and filters reduce risk—if you can afford them.

  • Moral dilemmas. A sick child with “clean” papers; a veteran with a dubious dosimeter badge; a talented engineer with an expired pass… law or conscience?

Modes & Goals

  • Story. Play through a season of shifts, balancing law, humanity, and your family’s survival.

  • Survival. An endless line, rising risks, growing demands, and a tight economy.

  • Endings. Save enough to send your loved ones to the “Clean Zone,” or… face a different fate.

Under Protocol is a game about order and compassion in a world after the end. Your protocol is your conscience. Your decisions are someone’s life.

short_description: 2027. One year since the superpowers’ standoff came to a head. The nuclear winter has lifted, but people still hide in bunkers, afraid of the radiation. Who gets a new home—and who is cast out into the wastes? Lives are in your hands, Captain.
